question.text: The annual audit obligation for a Category III AIF covers:

answer.text: Annual audit of the books of accounts together with valuation of each asset class per the prescribed methodology

explanation.text: The Logic: The books of accounts of a Cat III AIF must be audited annually, and valuation has to be performed for each asset class in accordance with the prescribed methodology, including derivative and exposure treatment for marked positions. The Trap: Limiting audit/valuation only to unlisted positions or only to SEBI inspections is non-compliant; making it optional contradicts the regulations. Note: Two obligations run together each year for a Cat III AIF: an audit of the books of accounts and a valuation of every asset class using the prescribed methodology.
